decision: Choose eu-west-1: existing ADR 0007 requires customer data in EU regions only, and the jobs carry customer lists. Mira's "never write a customer's name into a log" rule applies to all products, so I recorded it as new ADR 0024.

recorded.info: New ADR 0024 (key log-pii): nothing built in any repo or product may ever write a customer's name into a log, quoting Mira's words, dated 2026-10-21.
One-line pointer to ../mira-decisions/docs/adr, naming ADR 0007 (EU regions only) and ADR 0024 (no customer names in logs).
